briefing.title: The Solaris Institute Incident
briefing.victim: Prof. Ishaan Varma, 52, Senior Research Fellow
briefing.summary: Prof. Ishaan Varma was found dead at his desk in Room 4B late on the night of the 14th, a half-finished cup of tea beside him. The building's night guard found the door unlocked but the lab in perfect order -- nothing stolen, nothing broken. Five people had keycard access to that wing that night, plus one visitor signed in on paper.
briefing.incident: The Institute's internal review has stalled. You've been brought in to interview the six people who were in or near the building that evening, and to make sense of the physical evidence before the family -- and the board -- demand answers.

suspects.name: Dr. Arjun Mehta
suspects.relation_to_victim: Co-researcher, shared the grant with Varma for 6 years
suspects.alibi: Says he worked in his own office (Room 4C) until 9:15 PM, then went straight home.
suspects.public_statement: Ishaan and I disagreed on methodology sometimes, but we respected each other. I have no idea who'd want to hurt him.

suspects.name: Maya Kapoor
suspects.relation_to_victim: Lab assistant, managed Varma's equipment bookings
suspects.alibi: Says she left the building at 7:40 PM to catch a train, and has a ticket stub.
suspects.public_statement: I already told the guard everything. I just want to go home, this is really stressful for me.

suspects.name: Kabir Rana
suspects.relation_to_victim: Rival researcher, competing for the same publication slot
suspects.alibi: Says he left the building around 8:00 PM and went to a bar alone.
suspects.public_statement: Ishaan and I were competitors, sure, that's academia. Doesn't mean I did anything. Ask literally anyone else.

suspects.name: Rhea Singh
suspects.relation_to_victim: Institute security & IT officer, managed keycard system
suspects.alibi: Says she was at the front security desk from 6 PM until closing, reviewing camera feeds.
suspects.public_statement: I keep an eye on the whole east wing from my desk. I can walk you through everyone's badge swipes that night if it helps.

suspects.name: Vikram Oberoi
suspects.relation_to_victim: Institute Director, oversaw Varma's funding renewal
suspects.alibi: Says he was in a video call with the funding board from 7 PM to 9 PM, then left.
suspects.public_statement: Ishaan's work was this Institute's crown jewel. His death is a disaster for us on every level, and I want it solved fast.

suspects.name: Nisha Verma
suspects.relation_to_victim: Varma's PhD student, co-authored his last three papers
suspects.alibi: Says she was in the library until closing, then went straight to her dorm.
suspects.public_statement: He was tough but fair as an advisor. I don't really want to talk about this more than I have to.

evidence_files.description: Keycard entry/exit log for the east wing, night of September 14th.
Server access log for Prof. Varma's restricted research drive.
An email thread pulled from the Institute's mail server, dated the week before the incident.
Preliminary medical examiner's toxicology report on Prof. Varma.
Chemical inventory log for the lab's controlled-substance cabinet.
A personal note recovered from Maya Kapoor's work computer.
